summary: ts-node has had no release since 10.9.2 (Dec 2023) and handles ESM poorly. Node runs erasable TypeScript natively (type stripping on by default since 22.18 / 23.6, stable since 24.12 / 25.2). For enums, namespaces, parameter properties, decorators or tsconfig paths, use tsx.

replacements.name: tsx
replacements.when: full TS syntax, tsconfig paths, watch mode
